body:
S22-05: emily context build command added to emily.cli (cmd/context.go).
Compresses 16 Tier 1 golden docs via haiku bilingual compression, writes
EMILY/context/full-system-context.md. --dry-run flag available. go build + go test pass.

S19-01: Client-side portal travel verified already implemented. apps/lobby/src/main.c
handles PACKET_SCENE_CHANGE (type=6): reads new_scene + spawn pos, calls
client_apply_scene_id(), sets 500ms travel_overlay_until_ms. Item closed.

S19-02: Per-player physics isolation verified already implemented. C server
(apps/server/src/main.c) calls phys_set_scene(p->scene_id) before each player's
physics tick — sequential scene isolation, correct for single-threaded game server.

S19-06: SHANKPIT/docs2/NORTHSTAR.md updated with Steam launch plan.
Milestone 5 (EA build, FPS core only, $9.99), Milestone 6 (Steam Direct + launch),
Milestone 7 (BedWars + Dragonfly post-launch). BLOCKED items documented.
title: S22-05 emily context build + S19-01/02 verified done + S19-06 SHANKPIT Steam milestones
